task:
Fact-check three things for a Helix-style Rust editor (termina 0.3 + possible tokio): (1) Which popular LSP language servers support non-stdio transports (unix socket or TCP) in addition to stdio? Check specifically: rust-analyzer, typescript-language-server, clangd, pyright/pylsp, gopls. For each state the transport options (e.g. rust-analyzer --socket/--port?). (2) Does termina (helix-editor/termina, 0.3.x) have any async/tokio integration (event-stream feature, async reader), or is it strictly synchronous poll/read? (3) How does Helix bridge termina's synchronous event reading into its tokio event loop (helix-term/src/application.rs) — briefly, what mechanism (blocking task + channel, spawn_blocking, etc.)? Cite primary sources (GitHub, docs.rs, crates.io). Keep the brief under 400 words, bullet format.

criteriaSatisfied.evidence: Concrete findings with file paths and severity: (1) rust-analyzer stdio-only — crates/rust-analyzer/src/cli/flags.rs (lsp-server subcommand: only --version/--print-config-schema), open feature request issue #14473; ts-ls stdio-only — src/cli.ts (.requiredOption('--stdio')); clangd stdio/XPC-only — tool/ClangdMain.cpp (newJSONTransport(stdin, llvm::outs()) unless CLANGD_AS_XPC_SERVICE); pyright --socket inverted semantics — microsoft/pyright#3932; pylsp --tcp/--ws — pylsp(1) manpage; gopls -listen/-remote TCP + unix; sockets — gopls/doc/daemon.md. (2) termina 0.3.x: sync EventReader + event-stream feature (Cargo.toml: dep:futures-core) exposing EventStream in src/event/stream.rs (helper thread + PlatformWaker + mpsc task channel; no tokio dep). (3) Helix: helix-term/src/application.rs event_stream() -> termina::EventStream::new(reader, filter); event_loop_until_idle() consumes input_stream.next() inside tokio::select!; no spawn_blocking; workspace pins termina = "0.3".
